content_en: Eight months from three hundred million annual salary to two hundred ten thousand monthly income he bet right. Twenty five years big company experience he quit BCG annual salary four hundred twenty thousand dollars work All in AI. Jonathan Chan resume is brilliant. Twenty five years plus corporate experience. BCG Westpac bank fintech startups. Managed team from two to over two hundred. Annual salary four hundred twenty thousand dollars. Eight months ago he quit everything. All in AI. Now monthly income over thirty thousand dollars still growing fast. One. Why quit. Two words boredom. Also some fear. Twenty years he was promoted fifteen times. Great at climbing ladder. But he stopped creating things. He became person who reviews others work not person who creates himself. Then AI tools got good. Really good. He wrote code early ASP.NET JavaScript but technology evolved while he was in management meetings. AI became bridge. He opened Cursor mainly uses Claude Code describes what he wants in plain English. Somehow it worked. First weekend shipped product. Then another. Then another. He realized if he could do it millions of professionals could too. They just do not know yet.
